entries.title: The enemy-sprite pack the game uses was built from a commit that is not on the assembler's GitHub
entries.detail: The pack manifest says it was built from commit b7eae05f, but that commit exists on no branch of tilok1234/8-bit-sprite-assembler (remote HEAD is 2026-07-17, before the exporter work). The pack itself is validated and fine — but if the dev machine copy is ever lost, the exact tool version that made it is gone. Fix: push the exporter work (and the 48x48 boss pilots) from wherever it lives, then verify the commit is fetchable.

entries.title: Fresh copies of world_filler start on old, wrong code
entries.detail: The ruled mainline is claude/freeze-review-resolution-tf6bkf, but the repo's GitHub default branch is an older lane — so a fresh clone (or agent) lands ~12 commits behind on pre-freeze-resolution code with an obsolete HANDOFF that still calls the freeze provisional. Fix: set the GitHub default branch to the ruled mainline (doc 18 §11 item 3), and refresh stale local clones.

entries.title: Doc 16's version-snapshot table drifted within a day of being written
entries.detail: The hand-kept table still shows the pre-WYSIWYG dusk pack, SERIAL 12 as the only current line, and 'M7 all but export.ps1'. Fix: once doc 18 is accepted, the table is generated from ecosystem.lock.json instead of hand-edited.

entries.title: A newer dusk world export is finished and waiting to be handed to the game
entries.detail: WorldForge re-exported the dusk pack under behavior 63 (walkable count 34641 — furniture now claims the ground cells it stands on). The game still plays the earlier WYSIWYG export (34739). When it lands: full intake runbook (validate, battery, porosity re-pin, world_walk re-proof) plus the designer's city walk.

entries.title: WorldForge needs three art improvements from TileForge
entries.detail: Better road-band art, vertical (east/west) gate art, and an optional softer hedge repaint. Recorded in WorldForge's handoff but not visible in TileForge's own queue — this entry is the tracked record until the GitHub-issue half of the ask protocol is ruled.

entries.title: Game took in the what-you-see-is-where-you-walk dusk world
entries.detail: Historical entry for reference: WYSIWYG re-export intaken 2026-07-29 (~03:15) — boot + hash chain green, porosity pin moved 11 to 44 (gateway pass cells verified), world_walk proof PASS on three seeds, designer walked between the houses and accepted ('hallelujah! finnaly works').

entries.title: Game took in the 13-boss sprite pack (kept raw, not wired in)
entries.detail: Historical entry for reference: validated structurally (1248 images, every frame checked against its sheet) and committed raw 2026-07-29 (~12:45). Designer ruled: keep as-is, wire in only when a boss is naturally needed.
